Discussions highlighted that nations like Canada, Germany, and particularly Scandinavian countries possess steeper tax gradients, yet deliver remarkable public services and societal outcomes, leading me to reassess American priorities on taxing and spending. Given the value placed on progressive taxation and robust social services in these countries, I believe it's worthwhile exploring alternative approaches
